searchText: No not really...I measure the usage by number of issues on GH and chatter about it on Discord 😄 It feels like some people recently figured out it can be way faster. But still a niche thing I feel like the graph is mostly for dapp-level and higher-level data whereas with the client graphql API you can basically get the same data as with json-rpc API <@543900561460822016> As the official spokesperson for go-ethereum, can you let me know what it would take to convince the go-ethereum team to return the transaction hash of a transaction when `eth_sendRawTransaction` is called twice for the same transaction? Right now it returns an error, which is unhelpful and breaks apps when instead it could have just returned the hash and broken nothing. Related to this issue, which is on the topic but I think didn't really cut to the heart of the discussion back when it happened: <https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/issues/22093#issuecomment-1162978272> i can ask - in the mean time i opened an issue against the spec to track https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/245 Big PR to the json-rpc spec changing the format from json to yaml: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/246 will leave this up for 24 hrs in case anyone has thoughts/objections on this - i feel like it will make interacting with the spec substantially better though
